notes.title: 06-07-2022 Bug fixes
notes.content:
Chests no longer delete items when splitting stacks
 Chests can be closed as well as opened using the interact key (default: E)

notes.title: 06-05-2022 Mini content update
notes.content:
Hey guys!

After reading receiving some feedback on the initial release I've added a few QoL changes in the latest patch.

 Fog is less dense
 Corrupted Auras are less OP
 When you die you leave behind an "Aura Shadow" that you can loot to get your items back
 Doors now work correctly

Special thanks to DeltaDarkrai for the suggestions!

notes.title: 06-05-2022 Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the stone pickaxe mining speed was set to 5 seconds instead of 5, thanks BRoot
Optimized some AIs
Made the network syncing with the chests better
